messages:
alex: FYI — customer (acct 9182) reporting repeated parsing failures when they set response_format=json and strict=true. They sometimes get a 200 but body is HTML. Blocking their rollout.
maya: Can you paste a minimal repro curl and the raw response? Also: is this hosted or dedicated/private?
alex: Hosted first, seen on dedicated too. Repro curl:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite-1","input":"summarize: ...","response_format":"json","strict":true}'
```
Response (intermittent):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 124

<html><body>500 Internal Server Error</body></html>
```
Client then fails with: "invalid JSON: unexpected '<' at position 1". They say it started after auth token rotate (we rotated keys last week).
chris: Looks like Accept/Content-Type negotiation mismatch. Some edge proxies (nginx/error pages) return html for 5xx and those slip past our response_format enforcement when upstream returns 200 with wrong content-type. Also seen multipart/chunked boundary confusion when KV cache appended trailing bytes.
support-bot: [automated] matched pattern: upstream_content_type_mismatch. Request id: rwd-9182-2024-11-01T14:22:11Z. Logged to ticket #SUP-4821.
maya: Two asks: 1) confirm server-side enforcement order (do we prioritize response_format param over Accept header and Content-Type of upstream?), 2) repro steps we can give customer to confirm it's not client parsing (suggest curl without Accept header and with --raw to see bytes).
alex: Quick test: curl without Accept returns same. With --raw I can see chunked tail: "--kvcache-boundary\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\n\n" appended after JSON sometimes, which makes parser choke even when content-type is application/json.
chris: That indicates our post-processing (KV cache suffix) is sometimes being appended after the JSON body is flushed, and when an upstream 5xx page slips in, combined body is invalid. Workarounds: set strict=false (not ideal), or use response_format=structured which triggers extra wrapper that validates on server. Long term: enforce Content-Type + body validation before returning 200 to client and strip/repair trailing boundaries.
maya: For immediate escalation: can you attach full raw http capture and timeline, and note customer is in billing review (so high priority). I'll open an oncall label and ping infra.
alex: Attaching raw logs to SUP-4821 and adding stack traces. Repro window: 2024-11-01 14:20-14:25 UTC. Observed ~6/20 requests with bad body. Token used was from recent rotate. I'll include curl + --raw output.
maya: Thanks. I'll triage with infra, and we'll add a short-term platform guard: if response_format=json and strict=true, reject/return 502 if body is not valid JSON or content-type mismatches. Escalating to P1 until we confirm rollback for affected account.
chris: I'll open a runtime PR to validate body before KV cache append and add unit tests for chunked boundaries.
alex: Customer updated: they're happy to try strict=false temporarily but want fix asap — blocking release. SUP-4821 updated.
support-bot: [automated] incident label applied: responseformat-contenttype-ambiguity, priority P1.
